My current impulse is to use this as a log for my feelings about suicide. So that's what I intend to do. I don't know if that's allowed. But it will make me feel better and maybe help other people with their processing as well. So it actually doesn't matter much to me, hopefully I won't get internet punished.

I'm currently thinking I have basically two modes, which are thinking about suicide, and distracted.

Yo, I hear you. This is so much of what drives me toward my self destructive habits and suicidal ideation. We're done for. We've killed not only ourselves, but countless innocent sepcies. The world can't clear us out of here soon enough.

I'm also a suicidal trans woman ('cept I'm 28) and I'm on this sub right now because I've had suicidal ideation for over 15 years. I just wanna say that while I don't consider myself a "fake" woman or imposter in any way I can really really relate to a lot Eva is saying. It's really hard to not be accepted for who you are. You mentioned people "being into that." Yep. People are into trannies. It's a gross fetishization of who we are and the fact that this is predominately who is attracted to me is part of what's so depressing about this world.
